title: Holiday Gift Craft Cards
subtitle: 15 Christmas gifts kids can make, one card each: what you need and the quick steps
intro: Print, cut along the dashed lines and keep the cards in your holiday craft bin. Pick a card, gather the supplies, and make a gift together.

blocks.title: Gift Craft Cards
blocks.text: Each card has the ages, the time, the supplies and the steps from the article.

cards.title: Salt Dough Ornaments
cards.text: **You need:** 2 cups flour, 1 cup salt, 1 cup warm water, cookie cutters, acrylic paint, ribbon
list: Poke a hole for the ribbon
Bake at 200°F (95°C) for 2–3 hours, flip halfway
cards.tip: A straw makes a perfectly round hanging hole.

cards.title: Popsicle Stick Picture Frames
cards.text: **You need:** popsicle sticks, glue, paint, sequins or 'jewels', a photo, tape, a magnet strip
list: Glue 4 sticks into a square (or layer 8)
Tape a photo to the back
Add a magnet strip for the fridge
cards.tip: Perfect for relatives who live far away.

cards.title: Pinecone Fire Starters
cards.text: **You need:** large pinecones, old candle scraps or beeswax, a double boiler, dried herbs or cinnamon
list: An adult melts the wax in a double boiler
cards.tip: Hot wax and lighting are adult jobs. Keep children at a safe distance.

cards.title: Fingerprint Christmas Light Mugs
cards.text: **You need:** a plain white ceramic mug, black permanent marker, enamel paints
list: Draw a loopy 'string' around the mug
Bake as the paint instructions say
cards.tip: Great for teachers and coffee-loving parents.

cards.title: Bead and Pipe Cleaner Wreaths
cards.text: **You need:** green pipe cleaners, red and green pony beads, red ribbon
list: Thread beads onto a pipe cleaner
Twist the ends into a circle
Add a small red bow on top
cards.tip: Small beads: supervise children who still put things in their mouths.

cards.title: Scrabble Tile Ornaments
cards.text: **You need:** wooden alphabet tiles, glue, ribbon or a thin wooden slat
list: Spell a name or a word like SNOW or MERRY
Glue the tiles onto ribbon or a slat
cards.tip: A favorite for teachers who love literacy.

cards.title: Wood Slice Coasters
cards.text: **You need:** wood slices, paint pens or permanent markers, clear sealant (like Mod Podge), baker's twine
list: Add a coat of clear sealant
Tie a stack of four with twine
cards.tip: Lovely for new homeowners or the office.

cards.title: Cinnamon Stick Trees
cards.text: **You need:** cinnamon sticks, green ribbon or fabric scraps, a small star, glue, twine
list: Use the cinnamon stick as the trunk
Tie on ribbon: long at the bottom, short at the top
Add a twine loop for hanging
cards.tip: A great way to use up sewing scraps.

cards.title: Mason Jar Hot Cocoa Mix
cards.text: **You need:** a clean glass jar, cocoa powder, sugar, chocolate chips, mini marshmallows, stickers
list: Decorate the jar with stickers or a tag
cards.tip: A sweet gift for neighbors and bus drivers.

cards.title: Painted Rock Paperweights
cards.text: **You need:** smooth flat stones, acrylic paints, glossy varnish (optional)
list: Find stones on a nature walk
cards.tip: Made for a parent's or grandparent's desk.

cards.title: Hand-Drawn Ribbon Bookmarks
cards.text: **You need:** wide light-colored ribbon, fabric markers, a small charm or bead, glue
list: Draw holiday scenes with fabric markers
Glue a charm or bead to the end

cards.title: Tissue Paper Decoupage Votives
cards.text: **You need:** small glass jars, red and green tissue paper, half glue / half water (or Mod Podge), battery tea lights
list: Tear the tissue paper into small bits
Brush the glue mix onto the jar
Let dry, then add a battery tea light
cards.tip: Use battery tea lights, not candles.

cards.title: Birdseed Ornaments
cards.text: **You need:** 2 cups birdseed, 1 packet unflavored gelatin, 1/2 cup water, cookie cutters
list: Dissolve the gelatin in the water
cards.tip: Bird watchers and grandparents love these.

cards.title: Pom-Pom Gnomes
cards.text: **You need:** large white pom-poms, small wooden beads, felt, glue
list: Use a pom-pom for the beard
Roll a felt triangle into a cone hat
cards.tip: Make a whole gnome family as a set.

cards.title: Handprint Reindeer Dish Towels
cards.text: **You need:** plain white flour sack towels, brown fabric paint, fabric marker, a tiny red pom-pom
list: Press painted hands on the towel as antlers
Draw a face with fabric marker
Glue on a red pom-pom nose
cards.tip: A keepsake that comes out every December.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: Look for paints, markers and glue with the ACMI AP (Approved Product) seal, and write your child's name and the year on the back of every gift.

blocks.title: Gift Tags for Your Handmade Gifts
blocks.text: Cut out a tag, let your child fill it in, and tie it on with ribbon or twine.
